FAQ

Nova questions, answered.

What is Nova?

Nova is an AI booking agent for restaurants, cafés, hotels and holiday homes in Dubai and worldwide. It answers guests on WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and your website, takes bookings and sends reminders to reduce no-shows.

Can Nova connect to my reservation system?

Nova can send every booking to Google Calendar, Google Sheets or your team on WhatsApp, and connect to many booking systems through a webhook. Tell us which system you use and we will confirm the setup.

Does Nova reduce no-shows?

Yes. Nova sends WhatsApp reminders before each booking and lets guests confirm, reschedule or cancel in one tap, so you can give the slot to someone else.

Can Nova answer questions about my menu or rooms?

Yes. We train Nova on your menu, prices, dietary options, rooms, rates, amenities and policies.

Which languages does Nova speak?

Arabic, English and 100+ more. It replies in the language the guest writes in.

Can my staff take over?

Yes. Your team sees every conversation and can reply at any time. Nova hands over complaints and special requests automatically.

How long does setup take?

Setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call, and we agree the go-live date with you on that call.

How much does Nova cost?

Starter, Growth and Scale have fixed monthly prices shown on this page, with a one-time setup fee on monthly plans. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise. Enterprise is quoted based on your volume and integrations.
